findings.observation: Command palette dialog has slight backdrop opacity difference between Chromium and WebKit rendering engines.
findings.recommendation: Use unified backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/40 with WebKit fallback.

findings.observation: Collapsed FastTabs on Card Pages show titles but lack dynamic collapsed summary pills (e.g. "Balance: $12,450.00 • Active").
findings.recommendation: Inject summary expression evaluator so users can preview key fields without expanding tabs (matching Dynamics 365 Business Central FastTab summaries).

findings.observation: Code editor bottom status bar displays line/column but lacks Quick Shortcut chips (e.g. "Ctrl+Space: AutoComplete", "F12: Go To Definition", "Ctrl+S: Compile").
findings.recommendation: Add interactive quick-action chips in Monaco footer bar for superior developer experience (DX).

findings.observation: Document numbers and currencies in list views use proportional sans-serif font.
findings.recommendation: Enforce font-mono tabular-nums for document IDs (INV-2026-00001) and amounts for perfect decimal alignment.
